BS01.desc: Instantly teleports 400 units in the target direction, stopping short of walls.
BS02.desc: Removes all crowd control effects and grants crowd control immunity for 1.5 seconds.
BS03.desc: Restores 15% HP to yourself and the ally with the lowest HP% within 800 units, and grants both +20% move speed for 2 seconds.
BS04.desc: Grants a shield equal to 20% of max HP for 3 seconds.
BS05.desc: Deals 600 + 40 × level true damage to an enemy minion or monster within 500 units. Required to buy Jungle items.
BS07.desc: Burns an enemy hero within 600 units for 70 + 20 × level true damage over 5 seconds and reduces their healing by 50%.
BS08.desc: Become stealthed for 1.5 seconds and gain +25% move speed.
BS09.desc: After a 3-second channel, teleports to a chosen allied tower or your fountain. Taking damage interrupts the channel.
BS10.desc: Slows an enemy hero within 650 units by 40% and reduces their damage dealt by 30% for 2.5 seconds.
BS11.desc: Deals 150 + 30 × level true damage plus 25% of the target's missing HP to an enemy hero within 600 units.
BS13.desc: Stuns enemy heroes within 450 units for 0.8 seconds, then slows them by 30% for 1.5 seconds.
BS14.desc: Fires a flame bolt up to 700 units in a direction. The first enemy hero hit takes 100 + 20 × level magic damage and is knocked back.
BS15.desc: For 5 seconds, takes 30% less damage and reflects 35% of damage taken to the attacker as true damage.
EQ004.desc: Plain move speed. Limit one boots item.
EQ005.desc: Max HP and a little HP regen.
EQ006.desc: Attack power and bonus damage to monsters. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ008.desc: A little power, cooldown reduction and resource regen.
EQ010.desc: Move speed and a little attack speed.
EQ012.desc: Durability and bonus damage to monsters. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ013.desc: A little attack power and crit chance.
EQ014.desc: A little power and max HP.
EQ016.desc: Move speed and a little cooldown reduction.
EQ017.desc: A little attack power and lifesteal.
EQ018.desc: Power and bonus damage to monsters. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ019.desc: Unique Passive - Gale Chain: Every 3.5s, a basic attack also hits up to 3 nearby enemies for 100 magic damage.
EQ020.desc: Unique Passive - Warding Rift: +12 magic penetration. Damaging an enemy lowers its magic resist for 2s (3-10 per hit by level, up to 3 stacks).
EQ021.desc: Unique Passive - Thorn Retort: When hit by a basic attack, reflect 25% of the attacker's attack as physical damage.
EQ023.desc: Cooldown reduction, resource regen and max HP.
EQ024.desc: Attack, +8% physical penetration, bonus damage to monsters. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ025.desc: Unique Passive - Armor Breaker: Skill hits lower the target's armor by 25 for 3s.
EQ026.desc: Unique Passive - Scorch: Skill hits burn the target for 3s, dealing true damage equal to 3% of its current HP (min 10).
EQ027.desc: +25% shield and healing power, and extra HP regen.
EQ029.desc: Attack power, cooldown reduction and spell vamp.
EQ030.desc: Durability and bonus damage to monsters. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ031.desc: Unique Passive - Relentless Hunt: +15 physical penetration. 5 consecutive basic attacks on one enemy grant +30% move speed for 2s (15s cooldown).
EQ032.desc: Unique Passive - Frost Bond: Skill hits slow the target by 15% for 3s (stacks twice).
EQ033.desc: Unique Passive - Intimidate: Hits from enemy heroes' basic attacks cut their damage dealt by 6% for 2s (stacks 3 times).
EQ035.desc: Unique Passive - Lifeline: Below 30% HP, gain a shield of 360 (+8% max HP) for 3s (40s cooldown).
EQ036.desc: Armor-heavy durability and bonus damage to monsters. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ037.desc: Unique Passive - Frenzied Flurry: Critical hits grant +25% attack speed for 2s.
EQ038.desc: Unique Passive - Mending Severance: Skill hits cut the target's received healing by 50% for 3s.
EQ039.desc: Unique Passive - Thunderband Strike: The next basic attack deals bonus damage equal to 2% of your max HP and slows the target by 30% for 1.5s (1.5s cooldown).
EQ041.desc: Unique Passive - Zeal: +10% extra lifesteal while at or below 40% HP.
EQ042.desc: Power, spell vamp and bonus damage to monsters. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ043.desc: Unique Passive - Verdict Strike: After using a skill, the next basic attack within 3s deals extra true damage equal to 60% attack and heals 80 (+40% attack) HP (1.5s cooldown).
EQ044.desc: +40% magic penetration (ignores 40% of the target's magic resist).
EQ045.desc: Unique Passive - Curse of Wrath: Enemies within 420 take 8 (+1.2% of their max HP) magic damage per second. +50% against minions.
EQ046.desc: +17% move speed while out of combat.
EQ047.desc: Unique Passive - Tide of Time: Killing or assisting on an enemy hero cuts the ultimate's remaining cooldown by 35%.
EQ048.desc: Unique Passive - Impulse: Taking a hit of 10% max HP or more deals 100 magic damage to enemies within 350 and slows them by 30%. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ049.desc: Unique Passive - Executioner's Edge: Deal +25% damage to enemies at or below 50% HP.
EQ051.desc: Unique Passive - Guardian Shield: Gain a shield every 30s (starts at 300, grows as the match goes on, up to 1150).
EQ053.desc: Unique Passive - Undying Blessing: Once, a lethal hit leaves you at 15% max HP with a 300 shield for 3s (180s cooldown).
EQ054.desc: Unique Passive - Ambush Fang: +15% physical penetration. Every 10s, the next basic attack deals at least 50 true damage (grows with level) and slows by 30% for 1s. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ056.desc: Unique Passive - Echo: Every 6s, the next skill hit deals 120 (+50% power) bonus magic damage.
EQ057.desc: Unique Passive - Demonic Surge: Below 40% HP, take 50% less damage and gain +30% lifesteal for 5s (50s cooldown).
EQ058.desc: Unique Passive - Fiend's Boon: Killing or assisting on an enemy hero restores 10% of max HP.
EQ059.desc: Big max HP and strong HP regen.
EQ060.desc: Unique Passive - Reload: Killing an enemy hero restores 10% of max HP. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ061.desc: +40% physical penetration (ignores 40% of the target's armor).
EQ062.desc: Unique Passive - Bloodwing Resonance: +1.5 max HP per point of ability power.
EQ063.desc: Unique Passive - Twilight Challenge: Physical damage taken from a single hit is capped at 900.
EQ066.desc: A hybrid of attack and power with bonus damage to monsters. Requires Hunter's Mark.
EQ067.desc: Unique Passive - Life Reaver: Basic attacks deal extra physical damage equal to 9% of the target's current HP (max 60 against monsters).
EQ068.desc: Unique Passive - Reload: Killing an enemy hero restores 10% of max HP.
EQ069.desc: Unique Passive - Freezing Dominion: Enemy heroes within 600 lose 30% attack speed and 5% move speed.
EQ070.desc: High move speed with armor and magic resist.
EQ071.desc: +25% shield and healing power with cooldown reduction.
EQ072.desc: Heavy durability with bonus damage to monsters. Requires Hunter's Mark.
